review_scope: Owner-approved EEA topic-scope crosswalk v1.0.0 applied to Iceland national-source families N01-N06 and the EEA-EFTA layer E01, for pathways P01-P06.

scope_map.approval: Owner approved 2026-10-31. This map applies scope only; it does not accept legal texts or topics.

completion_rule: Do not mark a pathway or country complete from source count or link presence. Each route requires the controlling current primary text, applicable EEA layer, implementing rule, actual service procedure, decision-specific remedies, rights/attribution, and provision-level review; resolve critical open questions and report limits.

pathways.label: Access blocked before formal lodging
pathways.evidence_state: Official national law, forms, visa locator and appeal-board references exist as locators; no controlling lodging/receipt text is locally retained.
open_questions: Distinguish an appointment, inquiry or service-provider obstacle from refusal to accept a formal application.
Identify the deciding authority, mission, filing channel, timestamp that starts any statutory period, and available urgent review.
Map whether the EEA family route requires a visa application at all for the particular family member and facts.

pathways.label: Digital-only or service-provider access requirement
pathways.evidence_state: The official forms index and portal terms are locator/service evidence only; no complete legal or procedural text establishes a digital-only requirement or its exceptions.
open_questions: Determine which residence, visa and information requests are digital, paper-based, in-person, or delegated to a provider.
Verify accessibility, exception, proxy, support and alternative-submission routes from current official instructions and controlling rules.
Keep portal terms, forms, and the legal rule governing a particular process distinct.

pathways.label: EEA family proof and ordinary Schengen checklist
pathways.evidence_state: The family-card and evidence summaries are accepted project-authored summaries. Regulation 724/2026 is retained as full Icelandic legal text and adds a general document-authenticity/risk-assessment provision, but the current Regulation 540/2017 consolidation and Directive-to-Iceland provision crosswalk are absent.
open_questions: Map direct and extended family categories, dependency/durable relationship, entry documents and residence-card evidence under the EEA route.
Verify certified copies, translation, authentication/apostille, supplementary-document limits and alternate proof against current official law and service instructions.
Keep qualifying EEA family facilitation separate from ordinary Schengen C-visa requirements and national spouse/family-reunification routes.

pathways.label: Complaint, appeal or review-path information
pathways.evidence_state: The national statutes, Immigration Appeals Board guidance, selected decision publication route, courts portal, Ombudsman and Visa Act are locator references; no current full procedure/remedy text or decision-type remedy matrix is retained.
open_questions: For each decision type, identify the deciding body, appeal body, standing, operative deadline, notice/reasons, exhaustion rule, suspensive effect, interim measures and judicial route.
Keep the Visa Act complaint route, immigration appeals, administrative procedure, judicial review, Ombudsman and data-protection complaints separate.
Verify court and administrative decision-search scope, query dates and publication/redaction limits before describing precedent coverage.

pathways.label: Appointment access and processing clock
pathways.evidence_state: Current aggregate waiting-time guidance and an older historical processing page are distinct. Regulation 724/2026 includes priority-processing rules but does not establish the individual EEA-family statutory decision clock. Official registration guidance conflicts on three versus six months.
open_questions: Resolve the registration-threshold conflict against current primary law before reporting a settled duration.
Map appointment, submission, completeness, formal receipt, clock start, pauses/extensions, decision deadline, case status and escalation separately.
Report aggregate averages only with the authority's date, case category and denominator; do not present them as an individual estimate.

pathways.label: Personal-data access, minimisation and separate preservation request
pathways.evidence_state: The Information Act, Data Protection Act and authority/portal references are accepted as external references only. No full national data-protection text, EEA GDPR/JCD text or controller-specific record-access procedure is locally retained.
open_questions: Distinguish administrative case-file access from GDPR access, rectification, restriction, retention and supervisory complaint rights.
Identify the controller, record system, processing purpose, applicable GDPR/national provisions and any law-enforcement exception for the actual request.
Map a separate evidence-preservation request to the authority and procedure that control the relevant record.

cross_cutting_limits: All 36 external references retain scoped locator status; a URL is not a retained legal source text.
The three retained legal texts are complete amending instruments, not a current consolidated Foreign Nationals Regulation No. 540/2017.
The 2026 amendments concern Iceland's foreign-national rules; their application to an EEA/EFTA beneficiary must be checked provision by provision and against the EEA layer.
Icelandic EEA/EFTA, Swiss, Nordic, Icelandic-return and ordinary national family routes are distinct.
